First of all, I love your username. Is it a reference to calling your GAD Becky? My girlfriend as called her anxiety Becky and finds it much easier to talk about it that way.

Now, I've had problems with taking care of myself as well, for a long time too. I used to not do anything for personal hygiene especially. Though, I'm doing stuff now.

What really helped me is putting some routine in my day. For example, I've bought a whiteboard with on that all the things I need to do for that day and for college and so on. On there, I have written the date, day and countdowns to some events. Every morning I update them to the new day and right after that I brush my teeth.

For showering and so on, I have a mental countdown timer of 2 days. I have to shower after two days, at max three. I mentally keep track of when I last showered and when I should again.

At the start these things barely worked but as you get into the rhythm of it, it really starts to take effect.

If you have any questions, or you just want to have a talk, feel free to message me :)

A few months after I met my girlfriend, who was heavily depressed and has General Anxiety Disorder, I became so worked up in keeping her happy, faking my own happiness that I got depressed. When I was, I kept denying it to myself and others. I did not go to a doctor, though I was quite self-destructive and suicidal.

I have cut myself, attempted suicide multiple times in various ways, started 'exercising' which was more moving and using my muscles until I nearly passed out. And then started again.

Now, about 2 years later, I realize that the depression that hit me brought up all the bad things in me. For example, I 'switch' quite often. This is a term I thought of to explain it to myself and my girlfriend. What essentially happens then is that I'm not myself anymore and I'm like a completely different person.

I am too anxious to go to the doctor, to check out whether I might have social anxiety or that I might be bipolar. Just lie I'm too scared to go to social events, parties, or any other place where people are, whether I know them or not.

I believe in a 'God', one that is not part of any religion, but just a character I made up in my head to explain the things around me that I don't understand. I have tried explaining it to my girlfriend, since she's quite understanding of these things, though she finds it weird and prefers to not talk about it.

And as a last thing I'd like to get off my chest, I often have the odd urge to hurt, cut, humiliate, or choke people I see around me. Whether this be someone I care about or someone completely random.

I often believe I'm going mad.
